General.Name: Fortis Healthcare Limited
General.Description: Fortis Healthcare Limited operates as a healthcare delivery service provider in India. The company offers services in the areas of cardiac science, critical care, vascular surgery, dental science, dermatology, diabetology/endocrinology, emergency and trauma, geriatric medicine, liver transplant and hepatobiliary sciences, pain and palliative medicine, ENT, foetal medicine, gastroenterology and hepatology science, general surgery, and haematology areas. It also provides services in the areas of infertility medicine, internal medicine, mental health and behavioral science, nephrology, neuro surgery, neurointerventional radiology, neurology, obstetrics and gynaecology, oncology, ophthalmology, orthopedics, pediatrics, physiotherapy and rehabilitation, plastic and reconstructive surgery, pulmonology, radiology, organ transplant, rheumatology, thoracic surgery, transfusion medicine, urology, medical generics, endocrine surgery, and other support specialties, as well as treat infectious diseases. The company's healthcare verticals comprise hospitals, diagnostics, tertiary and quaternary care, and day care specialty facilities. Fortis Healthcare Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Gurugram, India.
